label: A9B55C9_hP146_176_hi_a2h8i_hi-001
title: (AlPO$_{4}$)$_{9}$(O$_{2}$)$_{9}$O [AlPO$_{4}$-17 Framework] Structure
comments:
This is another \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{AlPO$_{4}$ framework} with embedded O$_{2}$ molecules and free oxygens. It is remarkable because it exhibits negative thermal conductivity below 300K. 
 (Attfield, 1998) give two versions of this structure: one in space group $P6_{3}/m$ \#176, with one set of extra oxygens.  The second version is in space group $P6_{3}/mmc$ \#194, and only gives the bare framework. Neither set of coordinates agrees exactly with the data filed in ICSD 139992/CCDC 2211251, which includes all of the interstitial oxygen.  We use the structure filed with the ICSD and the CCDC, taken at 298K.  The AlPO$_{4}$-17 framework can be recovered by removing the O I, O V, O IX, O X, and O XI atoms.
